bio: It may be located in the historic Dorćol quarter, but Homa sports a thoroughly modern look and feel. Take a seat on the leafy terrace during the day or in the softly lit restaurant come nightfall to enjoy creative cooking with subtle Italian accents with a choice of two tasting menus and an à la carte lineup of vegetarian, fish and meat dishes. The tables are beautifully laid with white linen tablecloths, while the pleasant alfresco space is just the ticket for candlelit dining in summer....
